# Kira

**Kira 1 Alpha** is an independent Rust UCI chess engine with a small NNUE evaluation network trained exclusively on games generated by Kira. Created by **whosnds**, released by **KiraChess**.

[Download Kira 1 Alpha](https://github.com/KiraChess/Kira/releases/tag/kira-1-alpha) · [Installation and UCI](docs/INSTALLATION.md) · [Reproducibility](docs/REPRODUCIBILITY.md) · [MIT license](LICENSE)

## Get started

The prebuilt release supports **Apple Silicon macOS**, validated on **macOS 27.2 (arm64)**. It is a command-line UCI engine for use in a chess GUI; it does not include a graphical board. Intel macOS, Linux, Windows, and older macOS versions have not been validated for this Alpha.

1. Download `kira-1-alpha-macos-arm64.tar.gz` and `SHA256SUMS` from the release.
2. Run `shasum -a 256 kira-1-alpha-macos-arm64.tar.gz`, compare it with the archive entry in `SHA256SUMS`, then extract with `tar -xzf kira-1-alpha-macos-arm64.tar.gz`.
3. Add `kira-1-alpha-macos-arm64/kira1a` to your UCI chess GUI. Set **EvalFile** to the absolute path of the included `kira1a-retrained.nnue`, then set **Eval = NNUE**. Threads is fixed at 1; Hash defaults to 16 MB.

**NNUE must be selected explicitly.** The frozen binary starts in HCE mode, and its legacy default network path points to an earlier generation. Set both options above to use the released network and the measured configuration. See [installation instructions](docs/INSTALLATION.md) for terminal use and troubleshooting.

The prebuilt binary has no Rust installation requirement. It is unsigned and not notarized; macOS may ask you to approve running a downloaded executable.

## Measured strength

The release candidate's **internal Stockfish-UCI_Elo anchored estimate is 2194.6 Elo**, with a **95% confidence interval of 2149.2–2240.0**. This comes from 300 games at **60+0.6**, 100 each against Stockfish 19 UCI_Elo 1900/2000/2100, 64 MB hash and one thread per engine, using reversed-color opening pairs.

**This is not an official CCRL rating.** The measurement scale is “Elo on the Stockfish-UCI_Elo scale (nominally CCRL 40/4-anchored). Not a FIDE or Lichess rating.” No independent published-rating reference engine was available locally. The interval describes the estimator's sampling uncertainty; it does not quantify calibration or adjudication bias.

**PV/adjudication caveat:** fastchess recorded 5,289 Stockfish-named PV/bestmove warnings in the ladder. Reviewers matched the warning-named moves to the recorded Stockfish moves, but possible score-adjudication effects on **207 ladder games** remain unquantified. The 1,000-game soak also had 12,085 such warnings and 419 score-adjudicated Stockfish games. The warnings are retained as an unresolved limitation of the measurement.

| Existing verification | Recorded result |
|---|---|
| Move generation | 12 required perft vectors; 100,000 depth-3 differential positions, including 10,000 at depth 4; zero mismatches |
| Promotion | SPRT H1 accepted against Gen1 NNUE and Kira-HCE |
| Stability soak | 1,000 games; 838 wins, 32 draws, 130 losses; no recorded technical failures caused by Kira |
| Quantized parity | 100,000 positions; mean absolute difference 0.05168 cp, maximum 1 cp |
| Release packaging | Creator-metadata rebuild; search/evaluation logic and NNUE unchanged |

The soak is a stability/matchup check. Its score is not an Elo estimate. Release checksums, a concise measurement report, and the recorded evaluation games are available with the release. [Measurement notes](docs/MEASUREMENTS.md) describe scope and limitations.

## Build from source

```sh
git clone https://github.com/KiraChess/Kira.git
cd Kira
git checkout kira-1-alpha
cargo build --release --locked
./target/release/kira1a
```

The validated toolchain was **Rust/Cargo 1.98.1**. The engine has no external Cargo dependencies. Download the released NNUE separately and set its absolute `EvalFile` path and `Eval = NNUE`. Other build platforms are currently unverified.

The release credits **whosnds**. The executable was rebuilt only to update creator metadata; search and evaluation logic and NNUE weights match the evaluated Alpha. The recorded match campaigns were not repeated.

## Engine and training

Kira implements legal move generation, FEN handling, Zobrist hashing, make/unmake, PVS alpha-beta search, iterative deepening, quiescence search, transposition tables, killer/history move ordering, repetition and fifty-move handling, UCI time controls, and HCE/NNUE evaluation.

The network uses 768 piece-square inputs, two 128-neuron perspectives, clipped ReLU, side-to-move-first output, and quantized inference. Training used Kira's own record format and self-play data with Bullet's generic optimizer and Metal backend. Stockfish was used for perft checks and match opposition, never to label training data. Sliding attacks use direct ray scans.

See [score and feature conventions](docs/CONVENTIONS.md), [training pipeline](tools/train/README.md), and [reproducibility](docs/REPRODUCIBILITY.md).
